Crime Pattern in Metronolitan Cities
Crimes under Arms and Explosives/Explosive Substances Act
2.8.6 The incidence of cases under Arms Act in cities rose to 10,376 from 10,059 reporting an increase of
3.1 per cent over 1995. These cities reported around 15.4 per cent of the total cases reported in the country in
this year under this Act. Against the national level crime rate of 7.2, the cities such as Lucknow (88.6) and
Kanpur(84.3) reported a very high crime rate relating to violation of Arms Act. These pockets therefore appear
to be more engaged in clandestine activities in Arms and Ammuiniiions than the other cities. Incidence-wise,
after Delhi (3,406), more cases were reported from Lucknow (1,932) and Kanpur (1,922).
2.8.7 Similar is the case with reported cases under Explosives and Explosive Substances Act. Against the
national level crime rate of 0.6 only, Kanpur City (6.9) recorded the highest crime rate in this category followed
by Varanasi City (3.7). The total incidence during the year of 469 cases shared only 8.7 per cent at national
level.
